stem: A straight fence touches a circular pond at exactly one point, \(T\), as shown. The pond has center \(O\) and a radius of 10 meters. A post \(P\) on the fence is 26 meters from \(O\). What is the distance, in meters, from the post to point \(T\)?
solution: The fence is tangent to the circle at \(T\), so radius \(OT\) is perpendicular to the fence and triangle \(OTP\) has a right angle at \(T\).

explanation.B: Incorrect. This adds the squares, \(\sqrt{26^{2} + 10^{2}}\); \(OP\) is the hypotenuse, so subtract.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This subtracts the lengths, \(26 - 10\), instead of using the Pythagorean theorem.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This uses the diameter, 20, in place of the radius: \(\sqrt{26^{2} - 20^{2}}\).

verify:
choices = {o: choices[n] for o, n in {'C': 'A', 'B': 'B', 'A': 'C', 'D': 'D'}.items()}; answer = {'A': 'C', 'B': 'B', 'C': 'A', 'D': 'D'}[answer]  # shuffled: original letters
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert d('O','T')==10 and d('O','P')==26 and abs(ang('O','T','P')-90)<0.01
ans=sqrt(26**2-10**2)
assert ans==d('T','P')
assert simplify(value(choices[answer])-ans)==0
assert all(simplify(value(choices[k])-ans)!=0 for k in choices if k!=answer)
